chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Musa ibn 'Isa, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad through an intermediary, from Ja'far, from his father, peace be upon them.
That the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was asked about a man who is invited to a walimah and to a funeral: which of the two is better, and which of them should he respond to? So he said:
He should respond to the funeral, for it reminds one of the Hereafter; and let him leave the walimah, for it reminds one of the world.

key_terms.تُذَكِّرُ: causes one to remember and reflect
key_terms.ٱلدُّنْيَا: the worldly life and its immediate attractions
key_terms.ٱلْآخِرَةَ: the Hereafter, the final abode after worldly life
key_terms.ٱلْجِنَازَةَ: the funeral procession or funeral attendance

ai.seo_question: If invited to both a funeral and a walimah, which one should a person attend first according to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: The hadith teaches that when one must choose between attending a funeral and attending a walimah, the funeral is preferable because it brings remembrance of the Hereafter. It presents moral prioritization based on what softens the heart and turns attention away from worldly distraction.
